name: ibis Styles Bangkok Ratchada
short_description: A 266-room design-economy hotel directly in front of MRT Huai Khwang station with a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (1,154 reviews).
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bangkok Ratchada is located at the heart of Bangkok's New CBD and cultural district on Ratchadaphisek Road, with MRT Huai Khwang station right in front of the hotel — giving easy access to Sukhumvit, Silom, Hua Lamphong, the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, Chinatown, and Chatuchak Weekend Market. The 266-room property holds a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 1,154 reviews, with rooms ranging from 25 to 35 sqm and including Smart TVs. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 212 Ratchadaphisek Road, Huai Khwang, 10310 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 266 rooms with a strong 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 1,154 reviews
MRT Huai Khwang station directly in front of the hotel, with wide-reaching access across the city
Ratchada's New CBD/cultural district setting is a genuine alternative to the more touristy Sukhumvit corridor
cons: Ratchada is less tourist-oriented than Sukhumvit or Silom, which may suit some travellers less than others
research_highlights: MRT Huai Khwang station directly in front of the hotel

source_mix.label: Accor ALL — ibis Styles Bangkok Ratchada official page
